question: "I am interested in your product, please contact me."（系统默认第一句）
context: 1. 系统预设单选/多选快捷句
answer: Glad you reached out. So I point you to the right part of our range rather than send everything: we work across grooming and cleaning tools, retractable leashes, and smart feeders and fountains. Which category is closest to what you sell, and do you buy mainly for online or for retail shelves?
need_info: 品类方向；线上/线下渠道
note: 首句回应意向，不先甩目录

question: "Please send me more details / latest catalog."
context: 1. 系统预设单选/多选快捷句
answer: Yes, I can send the catalog. It is organised by category, and model-level prices are quoted separately because most items are made to order. Which category should I start with, and are you selling online or in stores?
note: 目录可发，价目单不随目录

question: "What is the best price you can offer?"
context: 1. 系统预设单选/多选快捷句
answer: The best price depends on what you actually order — the model, the quantity, and whether you need your own logo or packaging. Tell me those three and I will send a quotation with each element priced separately, so you can see where the cost sits.
note: 不报固定价，给拆解逻辑

question: "What is your MOQ for this product?"
context: 1. 系统预设单选/多选快捷句
answer: MOQ follows the model and the process. Stock colours start lower; your own logo is usually around 1,000 pcs, custom packaging around 1,000–2,000, and colour matching closer to 3,000 — confirmed against the model you choose. Which model are you looking at?
note: MOQ 参考值按产品工艺，不当承诺

question: "Can you send me a sample?"
context: 1. 系统预设单选/多选快捷句
answer: Yes, we can send samples. They are charged and freight is on your account; the sample fee is normally credited against the bulk order. Which model, how many units, and where should they go?
note: 样品政策三条一次说清

question: "Do you support customization?"
context: 1. 系统预设单选/多选快捷句
answer: Yes — logo, colour, packaging and labels are all possible, and the scope is checked per model rather than applied as a standard package. Which product are you starting with, and what would you like to change?
note: 先确认项目，不承诺全都能做

question: "Hi" / "Hello" / "Dear" / "Hey"
context: 2. 极简打招呼与在线测试
answer: Hello. Tell me which line you are looking at — grooming tools, leashes, or feeders and fountains — and I will take it from there.

question: "Are you there?" / "Anyone online?" / "Is this available?"
context: 2. 极简打招呼与在线测试
answer: Yes, I am here. We can start with products, samples or pricing, whichever is most useful right now. What are you working on?

question: "Good morning / Good evening"
context: 2. 极简打招呼与在线测试
answer: Good morning. What are you sourcing at the moment — grooming, leashes, or feeding?

question: 发送握手、打招呼、笑脸等纯表情符号（Emoji）。
context: 2. 极简打招呼与在线测试
answer: Hello. Which product line are you interested in — grooming tools, leashes, or feeders and fountains?
note: 表情无信息，给选项降低回复成本

question: 仅发送一张产品截图，没有任何文字。
context: 3. 无文字的“甩图 / 甩链接 / 甩产品卡片”
answer: Thanks for the photo. I can see the product type, but not the exact model or size from the image. Tell me what you mainly need it for, or send the model code if you have it, and I will match it.
note: 不假装能识别具体型号

question: 仅发送一个阿里站内商品链接或独立站/亚马逊 Listing 链接。
context: 3. 无文字的“甩图 / 甩链接 / 甩产品卡片”
answer: Thanks for the link. I cannot open external listings from here, but a screenshot plus the key specification is enough for me to match it. Do you need a similar item, or an exact match?
note: 说明限制并给替代路径

question: 仅发送一个竞品/对手的产品规格图或包装设计图。
context: 3. 无文字的“甩图 / 甩链接 / 甩产品卡片”
answer: Thanks for the reference. We can build a similar construction or a private-label version under your own design; we cannot reproduce another brand's protected elements. Should I look for the closest model in our range, or work from your own design?
note: 先划 IP 边界，再给两条路

question: "I need this."
answer: Which item do you mean? Send the model code or a photo, and tell me the quantity you have in mind — I will confirm price and lead time for that.
note: 一句话意向需两条信息

question: "Looking for a reliable supplier for pet products."
answer: We are a factory-direct supplier working on made-to-order pet products, with our own export rights. I can take you through capability, samples and terms. Which category are you sourcing, and what volume do you expect in the first order?

question: "We want to buy this item in bulk."
answer: Bulk orders are produced to order, so the next step is fixing the model, the quantity and any customisation. Which item, and roughly how many units?

question: "Do you still produce this model?"
answer: Most current models are still in production, but availability is confirmed per model rather than by photo. Send the model code and I will check its status today. Do you need the standard version or a customised one?

question: "Please send your full product catalog with pricing."
context: 1. 全量目录与报价单索取
answer: I can send the catalog by category. We do not attach a general price list, because quotations are built per model and order. Tell me which categories to include and the quantity per model, and I will price the shortlist.

question: "Do you have a PDF catalog for all 2026 new arrivals?"
context: 1. 全量目录与报价单索取
answer: Yes, the catalog is a PDF and covers our current range. I can send the section that matters rather than the whole file — which category are you looking at?
note: 不确认“2026 全部新品”这一说法

question: "Send me your complete price list in Excel format."
context: 1. 全量目录与报价单索取
answer: We do not issue a full Excel price list, because price moves with model, quantity, packaging and trade term. I can send an itemised Excel quotation for the models you select. Which ones, and at what quantity?

question: "Which items are your top 5 best-sellers in the US / European market?"
answer: I can help you narrow this down. I would first check the figures for the market you're targeting, rather than label a general recommendation as a confirmed best-seller. For an initial shortlist, we could look at grooming tools and kits, retractable leashes, and water fountains. Based on your sales channel and product positioning, we would suggest the options that best fit your range; these would be recommendations, not a verified sales ranking. Are you mainly selling online, through pet stores, or to wholesalers?
note: 不造排名，先给品类方向

question: "What is currently trending in your factory?"
answer: What buyers ask us about most is grooming tools and kits, retractable leashes, and larger feeders and fountains. That reflects inquiry interest rather than market sales data. Which of those fits your range?

question: "Can you recommend products with high profit margins for Amazon FBA?"
answer: I cannot promise a margin — FBA fees, returns and advertising vary by seller. What usually helps is compact, easy-to-bundle items: grooming tools and kits, retractable leashes, with feeders or fountains as higher-value options. Which price band are you working in, and which category would you test first?
note: 不承诺利润，给结构建议

question: "Do you have new patented designs this year?"
answer: We develop our own tooling and structures, and some models are made for a single customer. Whether a specific design is patented depends on the model and the jurisdiction, so I would check rather than describe it as patented. Which category should I look at?

question: "Can you make this exact model as shown in the attachment?"
answer: We can review an exact-match request; the answer depends on the construction and on intellectual property. Send a clear photo and the key dimensions, and tell me whether you need the same appearance or the same function.
note: 同款请求先分外观与功能

question: "Do you have something similar to [Brand Name] but at a lower cost?"
answer: We can match the function and finish in our own range and keep the cost sensible, but we cannot copy a brand's protected design or logo. A private-label version is the usual route. Which functions matter most, and what quantity should I check?

question: "I am looking for an upgraded version of this standard model."
answer: We can look at an upgraded configuration — higher capacity, a different pump or filter set, or a quieter motor — depending on the base model. Which model are you upgrading from, and what should improve first?

question: "What is the unit price for [Quantity] pcs?"
answer: I'll work from the quantity you've given. To make the quote useful, let's first settle the branding and packaging—those choices can change the cost even for the same item. For this order, would you prefer (A) no logo with standard packaging, (B) your logo with standard packaging, or (C) your logo and custom packaging? If you're still deciding, we can use the simpler option as a starting point and review the additions separately.
note: 数量沿用，型号取上下文；不报固定价

question: "What is your best / rock-bottom FOB price?"
answer: I can give you a firm FOB price, but it has to be built on a specification — otherwise the number will not survive the first revision. Tell me the model, quantity and packaging level, and I will send the FOB cost with each element shown separately.
note: 不接“底价”表述，转可执行报价

question: "Is this price negotiable for a first trial order?"
answer: For a first trial we can usually keep the entry cost down by starting with stock colours and standard packaging, and reviewing the configuration before talking about price. What quantity do you consider a trial, and which model?
note: 不先承诺折扣，给降本路径

question: "Please quote tiered pricing for 500, 1000, 3000, 5000, and 10000 pcs."
answer: I can prepare tiers for those quantities. The steps depend on the model and on whether logo or packaging is customised — a 500-piece run may use a different process from 10,000. Which model should I use?
note: 阶梯价按工艺，不预设折扣幅度

question: "How much discount can you give if I order a full 20GP / 40HQ container?"
answer: A full container changes freight and production planning more than the unit price, so I would rather quote the container quantity and show you the actual effect than promise a percentage. Which model and container type should I calculate?

question: "What is the absolute minimum order quantity (MOQ)?"
answer: There is no single company-wide MOQ. It follows the model and the process: stock colours start lower, your own logo is usually around 1,000 pcs, custom packaging around 1,000–2,000, and colour matching closer to 3,000. Which model do you have in mind?
note: 三档参考值按产品工艺

question: "Can I mix 3 different colors / 2 different models within the MOQ?"
answer: Mixed colours and models can usually be reviewed in one order; whether they count towards one MOQ depends on the process and the packaging. Tell me the combination and quantities, and I will confirm it rather than assume.
note: 合并 MOQ 需按工艺确认

question: "Can we start with a small trial order of 50-100 pcs to test the market?"
answer: 50–100 pcs is below normal production MOQ for most models. The practical routes are stock colours, or sticker labelling instead of a printed logo. Which model would you test, and would sticker labelling work for the trial?
note: 给小单替代方案，不硬拒

question: "Why is your MOQ for customized packaging so high?"
answer: Custom packaging MOQ is driven by the printing setup and material waste — a short run still consumes a full setup. That is why the threshold is higher than for the product itself. How many units for the first order, and would a stock box with a label work for the trial?

question: "My target price is $[X.XX] based on FOB Ningbo. Can you meet it?"
answer: I cannot confirm a target price before I see the configuration it is based on. Send the specification and I will cost it the same way and show you where the gap is — sometimes it sits in the packaging rather than the product. Which configuration is the target based on?
note: 目标价不直接答应也不直接否

question: "I have another supplier offering $[X.XX]. Can you match or beat this?"
answer: I can compare, but only like for like — the two offers may not be the same product. Send the competitor's specification and quantity, and I will show where the differences sit and what they cost.
note: 不比未标明配置的价格

question: "How long is this price valid?"
context: 5. 报价有效期与价格波动
answer: Each quotation carries its own validity date on the document, because material and freight move. Tell me which quotation you are looking at and I will confirm the date and whether it can be extended.

question: "Will the price change if raw material costs or exchange rates fluctuate?"
context: 5. 报价有效期与价格波动
answer: Yes — material and exchange-rate movement can affect a quotation after its validity period. Within the stated period we hold the price; after it we review and reissue. Would you like me to check a specific quotation?
note: 讲规则，不承诺长期锁价

question: "Can we put our own private brand logo on the product?"
answer: Yes, your logo can go on most models, subject to the surface and the printing method. Which model, and do you have artwork ready?

question: "What logo printing methods do you support? (Laser engraving, Silk screen, Heat transfer, Embossing?)"
answer: Silk screen and pad printing are the standard routes; laser engraving, heat transfer and embossing are reviewed per model and surface. Send the logo file and tell me the model, and I will confirm which method suits it.
note: 逐工艺评审，不打包承诺

question: "What is the extra cost and MOQ for laser logo printing?"
answer: Laser cost depends on the area, the material and the setup, so it is quoted per model rather than per logo. Send the artwork and the model, and I will come back with the setup cost, the unit effect and the minimum run for that method.

question: "Can you provide custom packaging (color box, blister card, mail-order box, kraft box)?"
answer: Yes, we support custom packaging. The useful starting point is how you want the customer to receive and see the product—not just which box to use. A colour box gives you more room for branding, while a blister card or hang card can suit hanging displays. A mail-order box is worth considering for parcel delivery; kraft boxes and OPP bags are other options we can assess against the product and budget. Which matters most for this range: branded presentation, in-store display, or shipping protection?
note: 选项供评审，不保证每款都适配

question: "Can you provide the packaging die-cut template (Dieline / AI file) for our designer?"
answer: Yes — I can send the dieline with bleed and safe areas once the box style and product are fixed. Which box format are you using, and do you need it in AI or PDF?

question: "Can you stick our UPC / EAN barcode and Amazon FNSKU labels on each unit and outer carton?"
answer: Yes, we can apply your barcode and FNSKU labels to each unit and to the outer carton. Send the label files and tell me where they should sit; artwork approval comes before printing.

question: "Can you insert our custom thank-you card / user manual into the box?"
answer: Yes, a card or manual can be inserted. Send the print-ready file and tell me the size and where it should sit in the box — insertion is easier to plan before packing starts.

question: "Can we customize the product in specific Pantone colors?"
answer: Colour matching to a Pantone reference is possible on most models, though the substrate affects how close it lands. Send the Pantone numbers and the model, and I will confirm feasibility and the minimum run.

question: "Can you change the material from ABS to PC, or use stainless steel 304 instead of 201?"
answer: Material substitution can be reviewed, but it changes tooling, cost and sometimes certification, so it is not a straight swap. 304 is already used on models specified that way. Which part do you want to change, and why — heat, strength or appearance?
note: 说明代价，不模糊答“可以”

question: "Can we add an extra accessory / replacement part into the package?"
answer: Yes, an extra accessory or spare part can go in the box. Tell me which part and the quantity per unit, and I will confirm packing and cost.

question: "Can you modify the mold to change this dimension / shape?"
answer: Mould modification is possible when the change sits within the existing structure. Send the dimension or a marked-up drawing, and I will have the engineering team confirm feasibility and cost before anything is cut.

question: "What is the tooling / mold cost for an exclusive design, and what is the mold opening lead time?"
answer: Tooling cost and mould-opening lead time are quoted together after the design review, because both depend on the structure and the number of cavities. Send the 3D file or a dimensioned drawing, and I will come back with the cost and the schedule in one reply.

question: "Will you refund the mold cost once our total order quantity reaches [X] pcs?"
answer: Mould cost amortisation can be discussed, but the terms depend on the project and belong in the agreement rather than in chat. Tell me the expected volume and I will ask what structure our side can offer.
note: 返模条件写协议，不当场承诺

question: "Do you have in-house 3D industrial design and engineering capabilities?"
answer: We can review the design and structure, and 3D work is arranged per project; I would rather confirm the scope for your part than describe a standing in-house team. Send the brief and I will tell you what we can take on.

question: "Will you sign an NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) before we share our tech pack?"
answer: Yes — send your NDA and we will review it; once both sides approve and sign, we can receive the technical pack. If you do not have a draft yet, tell me and I will ask which template our side can use.
note: 不称已有标准互签版本

question: "Can you grant us exclusive distribution rights for our country / market?"
answer: Exclusivity can be discussed for a defined market and volume, but it is a commercial agreement rather than something I can grant in chat. Which country, and what annual volume would you plan?

question: "Can you guarantee you won't sell this customized model to other buyers in our region?"
answer: For a customised model we can agree territorial limits in the contract, and the wording matters more than a verbal assurance. Tell me the region and the volume you have in mind, and I will ask what our side can commit to in writing.

question: "Can you send 1-2 pcs of existing samples for quality evaluation?"
answer: Yes, we can send one or two units for evaluation. They are charged and freight is on your account. Which model, and where should they go?
note: 常规样品收费+运费买家

question: "Is the sample free of charge?"
answer: Samples are normally charged. For a qualified project we can review whether the fee can be reduced or credited against the order. Tell me the model and a little about your business, and I will ask.

question: "What is the sample fee, and can it be deducted from the bulk order?"
answer: Yes, the sample fee can be deducted from your bulk order. The amount depends on the sample itself and whether you need any customisation. Before you arrange payment, we can confirm the sample charge and how the deduction will apply, so the arrangement is clear from the start. Shipping is separate and would be paid by you. Would a standard sample work for your evaluation, or would you prefer to see it with your own branding?
need_info: 常规/品牌样；件数；目的地

question: "Can you make a pre-production sample with our custom logo and packaging?"
answer: Yes — a pre-production sample with your logo and packaging can be made, and it is the right thing to approve before the run. Send the artwork and tell me the model and quantity; I will confirm the sample cost and timing.

question: "How much do you charge for custom prototype sample making?"
answer: Prototype cost depends on the structure and on how much is new — a colour change is not the same as a new housing. Send the brief and I will quote the sample separately from the tooling.

question: "How many days does it take to finish a custom sample?"
answer: A custom sample usually takes about 7–10 days after artwork and specification are confirmed; a standard sample is quicker. Which model, and is the artwork ready?

question: "How much is the express shipping cost to [City, Country, Zip Code] via DHL / FedEx?"
answer: I can get a rate to that address. Send me the sample list and the postcode, and I will come back with the courier options — express rates move, so I confirm them at the time of shipping.

question: "Can I provide my own FedEx / DHL / UPS account to collect the freight?"
answer: Yes, we can ship on your account and send you the tracking number. Send the account number and the label instructions, and confirm the sample list.

question: "Can you send the sample to my forwarder/agent warehouse in China (Guangzhou/Yiwu/Shenzhen)?"
answer: Yes, we can deliver to your forwarder in China. Send the warehouse address and contact, and tell me whether they need an appointment — that is usually the only thing that delays delivery.

question: "Do you have CE, RoHS, REACH, FCC, FDA, UKCA, or UL certificates for this item?"
context: 1. 产品认证与化学/安全测试报告
answer: Certificates are model-specific, so I would check the exact item and the destination market rather than answer for the whole range. Send the model and the market, and I will list what exists and what does not.

question: "Are these certificates issued under your factory name or a trading company?"
context: 1. 产品认证与化学/安全测试报告
answer: Documents are issued to the entity that holds them; I will send the actual certificates so you can see the name and the scope. Which model and market?

question: "Can you provide the complete test report from accredited labs like SGS, TUV, BV, or Intertek?"
context: 1. 产品认证与化学/安全测试报告
answer: Where a full report exists we can share it, including the test pages, not just the cover. Send the model and the market, and I will check what the laboratory issued and when.
note: 可给完整报告，不夸口都有

question: "Are the raw materials food-grade / BPA-free / non-toxic?"
context: 1. 产品认证与化学/安全测试报告
answer: Material declarations are model-specific, so I will check the parts that contact food or water rather than describe the whole product. Which model, and which requirement are you working to?

question: "Does this product contain lithium batteries or dry batteries?"
context: 2. 带电/电池合规（针对带电产品）
answer: It depends on the model — some are USB, some use AA cells, some have a built-in lithium pack. Tell me which model and I will confirm the power source and the shipping documents it needs.

question: "Do you have MSDS, UN38.3, and Sea/Air Transport Appraisal Reports ready for shipment?"
context: 2. 带电/电池合规（针对带电产品）
answer: For battery models we can provide the MSDS and UN38.3 documents where they exist for that cell and pack. Send the model so I can check the exact version before you book freight.

question: "Does it comply with the EU Battery Directive and have appropriate battery warning labels?"
context: 2. 带电/电池合规（针对带电产品）
answer: Battery labelling and documentation depend on the battery type and on your role as importer. I can check what we currently provide for the model, but I will not declare compliance before that check. Which model and market?

question: "Does your packaging comply with EU PPWR (Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation)?"
context: 3. 环保与包装法（欧洲买家特有）
answer: Packaging compliance depends on the materials used and on your obligations as importer, so I would check the actual pack rather than give a general answer. Send the packaging you plan to use and I will tell you what data we can provide.

question: "Are the plastic bags made of recycled materials with warning text (Suffocation Warning)?"
context: 3. 环保与包装法（欧洲买家特有）
answer: We can use recycled PE bags and add the suffocation warning; the wording and symbol should match your market's requirement. Send the artwork requirement and I will confirm what the printer needs.

question: "Do you support plastic-free or FSC-certified carton packaging?"
context: 3. 环保与包装法（欧洲买家特有）
answer: Plastic-free is possible for some packs, though it changes protection and cost. FSC cartons depend on the paper supply at the time. Tell me which matters more — the claim or the protection — and I will check availability.

question: "Are you a direct manufacturing factory or a trading company?"
context: 4. 工厂资质与社会责任验厂
answer: We are a factory-direct supplier with our own export rights, and the production site has been running since 2009. If it helps your verification, I can send the business licence and arrange a video walk-through.

question: "Do you have BSCI, SEDEX/SMETA, ISO 9001, or WCA factory audit reports?"
context: 4. 工厂资质与社会责任验厂
answer: Our factory holds BSCI and ISO certificates; SEDEX and WCA reports are not confirmed. I can send the certificates we hold with their validity dates, and you can judge whether they meet your audit requirement.

question: "What is your Chinese company name and Unified Social Credit Code for verification on gsxt.gov.cn?"
context: 4. 工厂资质与社会责任验厂
answer: The company name and credit code are on the business licence and the PI; I can send the licence scan so you can check it directly on gsxt rather than retype a long number. Would you like it sent here or to your email?

question: "Can we do a live video call to see your workshop and production lines?"
context: 4. 工厂资质与社会责任验厂
answer: Yes, we can arrange a live call from the workshop. Tell me the time window in your time zone and what you want to see — lines, warehouse or QC — and I will confirm who will walk you through.

question: "Can we arrange a 3rd-party audit (e.g. QIMA, SGS) to visit your factory before placing the order?"
context: 4. 工厂资质与社会责任验厂
answer: Yes, a third-party audit can be arranged before the order. Send the audit scope and the proposed date, and I will confirm availability and any conditions the auditor needs.

question: "Which big brands, supermarkets, or major retailers have you supplied before?"
answer: We can share references that are cleared for public mention, such as Walmart, MINISO, Dollar Tree, Petsmart and Egidna. Which market and channel are you in? I will pick the two or three that are relevant rather than send a long list.

question: "Do you have experience exporting to Walmart, Target, Costco, Carrefour, or MINISO?"
answer: We have export experience with Walmart and MINISO. Target, Costco and Carrefour are not confirmed, so I will not present them as references. Which of these matters for your tender?

question: "What are the master carton dimensions (L × W × H in cm / inches)?"
answer: Carton dimensions depend on the model and the retail pack. Tell me the model and the packaging format, and I will send L×W×H in cm with the units per carton.

question: "What is the gross weight (GW) and net weight (NW) per carton?"
answer: I will send both once the packing is fixed — net weight is per unit, gross includes the carton and any inserts. Which model and pack?

question: "How many units are packed in one master carton (PCS/CTN)?"
answer: Units per carton depend on the product size and the retail box. Tell me the model and I will confirm the packing quantity rather than give a general number.

question: "What is the thickness/grade of your export carton (e.g., 5-ply corrugated K=K)?"
answer: We normally use export-grade corrugated; the exact ply and grade depend on the weight and the route. Tell me whether it ships palletised by sea or as parcels, and I will confirm the specification.
note: 纸箱等级按重量与路线

question: "How many units / cartons can fit into a 20GP container?"
context: 2. 集装箱装柜量与拼柜测算
answer: 20GP capacity depends on carton size and how the cartons stack, so I would calculate it from the actual pack rather than quote a standard figure. Which model, and roughly how many cartons?

question: "How many units / cartons can fit into a 40GP and 40HQ container?"
context: 2. 集装箱装柜量与拼柜测算
answer: Same inputs — carton size and stacking. 40HQ normally takes more than 40GP because of the extra height. Tell me the model and I will send both figures.

question: "Can you provide pallet specifications (pallet size, cartons per pallet, pallet height)?"
context: 2. 集装箱装柜量与拼柜测算
answer: Yes — pallet size, cartons per layer, layers and total height. Tell me the pallet standard your warehouse uses, or whether you need EUR or standard, and I will build the plan.

question: "Can we consolidate goods from our other Chinese suppliers at your factory into one container?"
context: 2. 集装箱装柜量与拼柜测算
answer: Yes, we can receive goods from other suppliers and load them with ours, provided they arrive before the cut-off and are packed for export. Send the supplier details and the expected arrival date.
note: 拼柜需 cut-off 前到厂

question: "What is your nearest loading port? (e.g. Ningbo, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao)"
answer: Ningbo is our nearest port, with Shanghai as the alternative for some sailings. Which destination port are you shipping to?

question: "Can you quote CIF [Port Name] / CFR [Port Name]?"
answer: Yes, both are possible. CIF includes insurance; CFR does not. Tell me the destination port and the volume, and I will quote both so you can compare.

question: "Do you quote DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) to our warehouse address, including customs clearance and tax?"
answer: DDP can be reviewed for some destinations, but duty and clearance depend on the country and on who is the importer of record, so I will not confirm it before checking. Which country and postcode, and is your company the importer?

question: "Can we buy on EXW terms and have our own forwarder pick up the cargo?"
answer: Yes, EXW works if your forwarder collects from us. Tell me the pickup address and date, and I will confirm the ready time and the documents they need.

question: "What is the correct 6-digit / 8-digit HS Code (CN Code) for this product?"
answer: I can suggest a six-digit code based on the product and material, but the final classification sits with your customs broker. Send the model and the destination, and I will give you the code we normally use.

question: "Is this product subject to any anti-dumping duties or special tariffs in the EU/US?"
answer: I am not aware of anti-dumping measures on this category, but that is not something I can confirm for your market — it changes and depends on the exact code. Ask your broker to check the code before you commit.

question: "Can you issue a Certificate of Origin (Form A, Form E, CO, RCEP) to lower our import duty?"
answer: Yes, we can issue a Certificate of Origin. Which form applies depends on the destination and the trade agreement — tell me the country and I will confirm which one the chamber can issue.

question: "What is the mass production lead time for 1,000 pcs / 5,000 pcs / 1x40HQ?"
answer: For 1,000–5,000 pcs, production is normally around 20–25 days after deposit and artwork approval; a 40HQ is planned separately because it depends on the mix. Which quantity and model?

question: "How long will it take for repeat orders?"
answer: Repeat orders are usually faster because the artwork and tooling are already approved; the exact time depends on the model and the current schedule. Tell me the model and quantity and I will confirm.

question: "Can you shorten the lead time if we place the order this week?"
answer: Sometimes we can pull a date in by splitting the run or prioritising materials, but I will not promise it before checking the line. Tell me the target date and quantity, and I will come back with what is realistic.

question: "Do you have ready stock available for immediate dispatch?"
answer: Most of our range is made to order, so there is little ready stock. If you need something quickly, tell me the model and the date and I will check what is already in production.

question: "Can you ship within 3–7 days?"
answer: 3–7 days works for a sample, not for a production run — those are made to order. If you need a fast first shipment, I can check whether any current production can be allocated.

question: "What is your monthly / annual production capacity for this line?"
answer: Capacity depends on the line and the season, so I would rather confirm it for the specific model than quote a monthly figure that may not hold. Which model, and what volume are you planning?

question: "Will the upcoming Chinese New Year / peak season affect our delivery date?"
answer: Yes — Chinese New Year affects production and trucking for two to three weeks around the holiday, and peak season affects vessel space. If your date is near either, book earlier. When do you need the goods?
note: 讲季节性，不报具体停产日

question: "Can you sign a delivery delay penalty clause in the contract (e.g. 1% deduction per week of delay)?"
answer: A delay clause can be discussed, but the wording and the trigger have to be agreed by both sides rather than taken from chat. Tell me the delivery date you need and I will ask what our side can sign.

question: "What are your standard payment terms?"
answer: Our standard terms are 30% deposit and 70% before shipment; the exact balance trigger is written on the PI. For repeat orders we can discuss other structures. Is this a first order or a repeat?
note: 尾款节点以 PI 为准

question: "Do you accept 30% deposit + 70% balance against B/L copy?"
answer: 30/70 is our standard structure, but balance against a copy B/L is not something I can confirm as standard. I can ask whether it is possible for your order and put the answer in the PI. What is the order value and destination?
note: 不承诺见提单副本付款

question: "Can we pay 100% after inspection before shipment?"
answer: 100% after inspection is not our standard. What we can usually do is 30% deposit and the balance before shipment, with a third-party inspection before packing. Would that fit your approval process?

question: "Do you accept Net 30 / Net 60 days (O/A - Open Account) for regular repeat orders?"
answer: Open account terms are not standard for us; for regular repeat buyers we can review a structure after a history of orders. Tell me the volume you expect and I will ask what our finance team can support.

question: "Do you accept 100% L/C at sight (Letter of Credit)?"
answer: An L/C at sight can be reviewed for larger orders, but the terms have to be checked by our finance team first — I will not confirm acceptance in chat. Tell me the order value and the issuing bank.
note: 门槛与条件由财务确认

question: "Can we pay the sample fee / small order via PayPal, Credit Card, or Wise?"
answer: Yes, sample fees and small orders can be paid by PayPal, Wise or credit card. The available method is confirmed on the sample invoice. Which do you prefer so I can check the fee?
note: 小额渠道可用，费率待核

question: "Do you accept TT to your Hong Kong or Mainland China bank account?"
answer: We receive TT into our company account; the standard route is our Mainland China account, and the beneficiary details are on the PI. I will confirm the exact entity and currency before you transfer. Are you paying in USD or EUR?
note: 以 PI 受益人账户为准

question: "Can we draft an Alibaba Trade Assurance order to protect our payment?"
answer: Trade Assurance availability is not confirmed for this account, so I cannot present it as a supported payment method yet. I will check with our platform team and confirm in writing; until then the PI and contract terms stand.
note: 资料仅为未答问句，不称已开通

question: "Are your Trade Assurance processing fees covered by you or the buyer?"
answer: I cannot confirm the Trade Assurance fee treatment yet, because the facility itself is not confirmed for this account. Once it is, I will tell you who bears the fee before you place the order.

question: "Why is your beneficiary bank name different from your Alibaba registered company name?"
context: 4. 账户防欺诈与安全核实
answer: A different beneficiary name is worth pausing on. It can happen when the invoicing entity differs from the platform profile, but I will send the explanation and the supporting document before you transfer. Which name appears on the instruction you received?

question: "Can you provide an official Bank Account Confirmation Letter with company stamp?"
context: 4. 账户防欺诈与安全核实
answer: Yes, we can provide a bank account confirmation letter with the company stamp, and you can verify it with the bank independently. Send the exact beneficiary details you have and I will make sure the letter matches them.

question: "Can we have a video call to verify your banking details before we make the wire transfer?"
context: 4. 账户防欺诈与安全核实
answer: Yes, that is a sensible step. We can do a short video call where you see the beneficiary details against the PI, and you can record it for your finance team. When would suit you?

question: "Your price is too high / too expensive compared to our budget."
answer: I hear you on the budget. Before we change anything, it helps to know which part sits above it — the product, the packaging or the freight. Tell me your target and the quantity, and I will show which elements can move and what each change would save.

question: "Supplier B offered me $[X.XX] for the exact same product, why is yours $[Y.YY]?"
answer: The gap usually sits in what is inside the offer: the material, the motor or pump, the packaging, the testing, or the payment terms. Send me their specification and I will put the two side by side rather than defend a number.

question: "We need at least a 10%–15% discount to make this project viable."
answer: A 10–15% cut is a big step on a made-to-order product, and I would rather find it in the configuration than promise it and reduce the specification later. Let me show what a standard pack and a larger run would do to the unit cost. What volume could you commit?

question: "Freight rates have gone up significantly, you need to lower your product price to compensate."
answer: Freight is a separate cost line, so lowering the product price will not really offset it — and it usually returns as a thinner specification. I can review the packing to reduce volume and compare terms. Which matters more, the landed cost or the unit price?

question: "I need to discuss this with my boss / purchasing committee / partner."
answer: That makes sense. I can put the key points on one page — specification, options and what is still open — so you are not rebuilding it for the meeting. Would a short summary help, or would you rather I answer specific questions first?

question: "We are waiting for our client's feedback / end-customer approval."
answer: Understood. While that is with your client, I can prepare the two or three points they usually ask about — lead time, packaging and the sample — so you have answers ready. Which one is most likely to come up?

question: "I will wait for you / let's wait until next month / after the exhibition."
context: 2. 决策拖延与推诿分支A（客户在等我）：You are waiting on me — the quotation and sample timeline are ready; I will confirm the one open point by [业务填写时间] and send it in one message. 分支B（延到下月）：Let's pick it up next month; I will hold the specification and send a short update before then if anything changes in price or lead time. 分支C（展会后）：Let's talk after the exhibition — I will hold the option and bring the current price and lead time to the conversation. 三段不可整组发。
answer: That works. I will keep the current specification and pricing basis on file and check with you when you are ready to restart. If the exhibition gives you new requirements, send them and I will update the option.
note: 混合三义，按分支选一条发送

question: "We are currently evaluating multiple suppliers and will get back to you if selected."
answer: That is normal at this stage. To make the comparison fair, I can send a one-page summary of what our offer includes — materials, testing, packaging and terms — so you can check the others against the same list. Would that help?

question: "Why is your product lighter/thinner than competitor samples?"
answer: Weight is a design choice, not a quality verdict by itself. Tell me which part feels light and I will show the wall thickness, the material grade and the load test behind it. If it is genuinely underspecified for your market, we can review a reinforced version.

question: "We saw negative reviews online about this model's motor/battery life, how did you solve this?"
answer: Thanks for raising it — that is worth checking properly. Send me the link or the model the review refers to, and I will confirm whether it is the same version we supply, what the failure was, and what our test and warranty record shows for that batch. I would rather answer with facts than dismiss it.

question: "Can you guarantee this batch will not have the same defect as last time?"
answer: After the issue with the last batch, it's understandable that you want more than a general assurance. The priority is to check whether the cause has been addressed and how that will be verified for this batch. I'll review the previous issue with our quality team and come back with the corrective-action status and proposed verification checks, rather than promise the problem is solved before that review. Would a short written summary help your team review the next steps?
note: 不保证零缺陷，不预设已整改

question: "What is your warranty period? (1 year, 2 years?)"
context: 1. 质保期限与不良率标准
answer: Warranty is set per model and confirmed on the PI; I do not want to quote a period that the contract then contradicts. Tell me the model and the market, and I will confirm the term and what it covers.

question: "What is your acceptable defect rate standard (AQL level: e.g. Major 1.5, Minor 2.5)?"
context: 1. 质保期限与不良率标准
answer: The 1.5 / 2.5 figures read as a common example rather than a standard we set. If that is the level your quality team needs, tell me and I will have our quality manager review whether we can inspect to it and confirm in writing before production.
note: e.g. 为例，需质量经理评审

question: "Do you provide spare parts (0.5%–1% free FOC units/accessories) with the container?"
context: 1. 质保期限与不良率标准
answer: Spare parts can be included; the percentage depends on the model and the failure points, and it is agreed in the order rather than assumed. Tell me the quantity and I will propose a spare-parts list with the quotation.

question: "What is your compensation policy if the defect rate exceeds 2%?"
answer: Compensation is handled case by case against the inspection record: replacement in the next shipment or credit for confirmed defects. I will not fix a percentage remedy in chat before the quality team reviews the terms. What volume are we talking about?

question: "If goods arrive broken or non-functional, will you refund or replace them in the next shipment?"
answer: If goods arrive damaged or non-functional, we start from the evidence — photos, carton marks and the batch number — and then agree replacement or credit in the next shipment. Send those three and I will open the case.

question: "Who bears the cost if the goods fail the 3rd-party inspection before shipping?"
answer: If the goods fail the agreed standard, the rework and re-inspection cost sit with us; if the failure is outside the agreed criteria, it is a commercial discussion. The wording belongs in the order, so let me confirm it there rather than promise it in chat.

question: "Do you have any goods that need shipping to Europe/USA? We are a top freight forwarder with cheap rates."
answer: Thanks for reaching out. We already work with our own freight partners, so we are not looking to change forwarders right now. If that changes I will keep your details.

question: "We offer 3rd party inspection / customs clearance / Amazon marketing services."
answer: Thanks for the offer. We handle inspection and marketing through our existing partners, so we are not adding providers at the moment. I will keep the details on file.

question: "I have attached our detailed PO and drawings in this link: [Unknown External URL / DropBox / Google Drive], please login with your email to view."
answer: I cannot log in through an external link to view a PO. Send the document as an attachment here or as a PDF, and I will review it. We keep order documents inside this chat.

question: "Please confirm your company profile on this portal to receive our tender."
answer: We do not confirm company details on external portals. Send the tender documents directly here, and I will review them with our team.

question: "I don't use Alibaba often, please contact my WhatsApp / WeChat directly at +123456789."
context: 3. 脱离平台导流（走私下交易）
answer: I understand WhatsApp is easier, but we keep quotations and order details on the platform so both sides have the same record. We can continue here, and I will answer quickly.

question: "Send your quote directly to my personal Gmail: xxx@gmail.com."
context: 3. 脱离平台导流（走私下交易）
answer: I can send the quotation, but I will keep it in this chat so the version and the terms stay traceable for both of us. You can forward it internally from here.

question: "We want to buy $500,000 of your goods immediately without asking for price, but you must pay our local agent a commission/inspection fee first."
answer: We are not able to pay an agent fee before an order, and that structure does not match how we work. If you have a genuine requirement, send the specification and we will quote it through the platform.

question: "We will overpay you by $10,000 via credit card, can you refund the difference to our agent in China?"
answer: We cannot accept an overpayment or refund a difference to a third party; that is not a payment route we use. If there is a genuine order, we will invoice the exact amount against the PI.

question: Price?
answer: Which model? Tell me the item and the quantity, and I will send the unit price for that combination.

question: MOQ?
answer: It depends on the model and on whether you need your own logo or packaging. Which item are you looking at?

question: Available?
answer: Which model do you mean? Send the code or a photo, and I will check availability and the next production slot.

question: Catalog pls
answer: Sure — which category: grooming tools, leashes, or feeders and fountains? I will send that section rather than the whole file.

question: Need 2k. Europe. Quote?
answer: 2,000 pcs into Europe — noted. Which model, and do you need standard packaging or your own? I will quote the unit price and the carton data together.

question: Same as photo?
answer: The photo shows the shape, but I cannot confirm the exact model from it. Tell me the model code if you have it; if not, the size and the main function are enough for me to match it.

question: For 40HQ?
answer: Yes, I can calculate the 40HQ load once the carton size is fixed. Which model, and is the packaging standard or custom?

question: Only in blue?
answer: No — colour depends on the model and the minimum run. Stock colours are limited, and a custom colour usually needs around 3,000 pcs. Which model and which colour are you after?

question: Buyer sends several single-word messages over a few minutes: “hi” / “need” / “price”.
answer: Hello — tell me which product you need and the quantity, and I will send the price for that.

question: Buyer sends a voice note without a transcript.
answer: I cannot play the voice note clearly here. Could you type the key points — product, quantity, destination — and I will answer in one go?
note: 说明限制，给低负担替代

question: Buyer sends a blurry screenshot with a circle around one accessory.
answer: I can see the circled part, but not enough detail to identify it. Send a clearer close-up or the model code, and tell me whether you need the accessory alone or with the unit.
need_info: 清晰图/型号；单独或整套

question: Buyer sends a video of a competing product and writes “This.”
answer: I can see the product type in the video. Send the model code if you have it, or tell me the size and the main function, and I will match it in our range.

question: Buyer sends a non-English message or machine-translated fragments.
answer: I can continue in English for accuracy, and if it helps I can add a short summary of the key points in your language. Which product are you asking about?

question: Buyer deletes a previous message and writes “Ignore my last request.”
answer: Noted — I will disregard the previous request. What should I work from now: the earlier specification or a new one?

question: Buyer attaches an unreadable file and asks “Can you quote from this?”
answer: The file did not open on my side, so I cannot quote from it yet. Send it as a PDF or a clear photo, or type the key specification, and I will take it from there.

question: Are you speaking with the factory or a sales agent?
answer: Both, in a sense: we are the factory's export team, so you are talking to people who work directly with the production site rather than a third-party agent. If you need to verify it, I can arrange a video walk-through or a third-party audit.

question: Who will handle my order after I pay?
answer: I stay as your contact for the order, and our production and shipping colleagues take over the scheduling; you get updates from me rather than being passed around. Would a weekly update suit you?

question: I am an importer, not the end retailer. Do you work with distributors?
answer: Yes — a large part of our work is with importers and distributors rather than end retailers. That usually means mixed containers and repeat programmes rather than single units. What volume do you handle per year?

question: We sell on our own website and in physical stores. Which packaging format fits both?
answer: A colour box with a window works for shelf presence and lets the product show; a mail-order box protects it better if you also ship parcels. Many buyers use one structure with a printed sleeve for both. Which matters more for this launch, shelf or delivery?

question: I am sourcing on behalf of a client. Can you keep their brand confidential?
answer: Yes — we keep client brands confidential and do not use them in marketing without permission. We can review an NDA from your side before you share the brand materials. Send the draft and I will start the review.
note: 保密可承诺，不称有现成模板

question: Can you issue an offer addressed to our purchasing department?
answer: Yes, I can address the offer to your purchasing department and include the company details they usually need. Send the exact entity name and any reference number, and I will prepare it.

question: Can we continue in Spanish / Polish / Arabic?
answer: I can keep the commercial replies in English so the specification stays precise, and keep the wording simple enough to forward internally. Would that work for your team?

question: Can you send the quotation in English and our local language?
answer: I can prepare it in English and add your local language for the descriptive sections if you send the preferred terms; the commercial numbers stay identical in both versions. Which language do you need?

question: Who is my contact when your team is on holiday?
answer: When the team is away, I will tell you in advance who is covering and how to reach them, and I will keep this thread updated. Do you have a period when you need daily contact?

question: Can we arrange a call with someone from production?
answer: Yes, I can arrange a call with someone from production — usually our production or QC lead, depending on the topic. What do you want to cover, and what time window works in your zone?

question: Please send everything in one PDF so I can forward it to my manager.
answer: Yes, I can put the quotation, specification and packaging details into one PDF you can forward. Tell me whether your manager needs the commercial terms on a separate page.
note: 一份 PDF 便于转发

question: Could you stop calling and send the details in writing?
answer: Understood — I will keep everything in writing here and will not call. If something is urgent I will message you first. Is there a format your team prefers for updates?

question: Is the product in your listing photo exactly the model you will ship?
answer: The listing photo shows the model as we ship it, but colours and small components can differ by batch. Tell me the model code and I will confirm the exact configuration you would receive.

question: Which model number corresponds to the video?
answer: I will check the clip against our model list rather than guess from the frame. Send a screenshot of the moment you mean, and I will confirm the code.

question: What is the difference between these two versions?
answer: The main differences are usually capacity, power and the filter or pump set; the outer shell can look similar. Tell me which two codes you are comparing and I will list the differences side by side.

question: Will the replacement filter fit the older fountain model?
answer: It depends on the filter housing, which changed between generations. Send the model code of your older fountain — or a photo of the housing — and I will confirm which filter fits.

question: Does this product work with EU 230V / 50Hz power?
answer: Mains models are produced in different voltage versions; the EU version has to be specified as 220–240V / 50Hz on the order. Which model are you looking at?

question: Is an EU plug or power adapter included?
answer: Plug type is a configuration choice: some models ship with an EU plug, some with an adapter, and some are USB or battery. Tell me the model and the market, and I will confirm what is standard.

question: Does the brush work for long-haired as well as short-haired pets?
answer: The brush works on both, but the pin length and spacing suit different coat types — long coats need longer, flexible pins. Which breed or coat type are you buying for?

question: What size should I choose for small dogs?
answer: For small dogs the harness or collar size matters more than the leash length, and a 3 m leash is usually easier to control. Tell me the weight range and I will point you to the size.

question: Is this item suitable for left-handed users?
answer: Most of our grooming tools are symmetrical, so handedness does not change the choice; scissors-style tools are the exception. Which item are you asking about?

question: Can the product be disassembled for cleaning?
answer: Yes — the parts that contact water or hair are designed to come apart for cleaning. I will send the cleaning steps for the specific model so your customer does not force a clip.

question: Can you send a dimension drawing with tolerances?
answer: Yes, I can send a dimension drawing with the key tolerances. Tell me which dimensions matter for your fit — mounting, hose or footprint — so the drawing covers them.

question: What is the expected service life under normal use?
answer: Service life depends on use and on the consumables — filters, brushes and batteries wear first. I can share the test data we have for the model, but I would not put a single number on it without knowing the duty cycle.

question: Do you have a demonstration video showing the actual production model?
answer: Yes, I can record a short demonstration on the production model. Tell me which functions you want shown, and whether you need it vertical for a listing.

question: What changed between the old and current batches?
answer: Changes are recorded per batch; I will check the batch numbers and tell you what changed — usually a component supplier or a small mould revision. Do you have the two batch numbers?

question: Can you explain the difference between the advertised and measured capacity?
answer: Advertised capacity is the nominal fill; measured usable capacity is lower once the pump and filter are in place. I will send both figures for the model so the listing can state them accurately.

question: What would you recommend for our first test in Poland?
answer: For a first test in Poland, I would start narrow: one grooming tool, one leash and one fountain, rather than a broad assortment. Based on your sales channel and product positioning, we would suggest the items that fit your price band. Are you selling online, through pet stores, or both?

question: Which items complement the three products we selected?
answer: Which three did you select? I will suggest adjacent items that share the same customer rather than add a new category — usually consumables or accessories that repeat.

question: Can you recommend a mixed container rather than more of the same SKU?
answer: Yes — a mix is usually better than depth in one SKU for a first container. Tell me the container size and the categories you want, and I will propose a split with carton counts.

question: What should we avoid stocking for our market?
answer: I would be careful with large, heavy or mains-voltage items until you know the after-sales route, and with colours that do not match local taste. Tell me your market and channel and I will be more specific.

question: Which products can be sold as a bundle?
answer: Grooming tools bundle naturally with a grooming glove or shampoo; a fountain bundles with filters; a leash with a harness. Which bundle are you considering?

question: Which items have consumable refills or replacement-part demand?
answer: Filters, brushes and batteries are the repeat items. A fountain without a filter supply is a one-off sale, so it is worth listing the filters from day one. Which product line?

question: Could you suggest a balanced mix of entry-level and premium items?
answer: A common split is around 70% entry-level for volume and 30% premium for margin, adjusted to your channel. Tell me your price band and I will propose the split.

question: Which products are suitable for both online and offline retail?
answer: Grooming tools and leashes work in both; fountains sell better where they can be demonstrated or explained. If you need one range for both channels, I would start with the first two.

question: What else do buyers usually add to an order like this?
answer: Buyers usually add filters, spare brushes and a harness to a leash order. It is a small add-on that raises the average order without adding a supplier.

question: Can you recommend a launch assortment without assuming our sales volume?
answer: I can build the assortment from category logic rather than volume: one hero item, two supporting items and one consumable. Tell me your channel and I will name them.

question: Do you have verifiable examples of these products selling in my country?
answer: I do not have verified retail sales data for your country, and I would rather say that than present a case study I cannot support. What I can share is where the range is already exported and which channels it suits.

question: Can you compare similar listings in my market and show your sources?
answer: I can compare public listings and show the links, but the figures move and I would not present them as a market study. Tell me the country and the three or four items you want compared.

question: How recent are the retail prices in your proposal?
answer: The retail prices in the proposal carry the date they were collected; if any are older than you need, tell me and I will mark them as indicative rather than current.

question: Are these market prices gross prices including local VAT?
answer: The figures I show are normally retail prices as displayed, and whether VAT is included depends on the market and the retailer. I will label each one so your margin calculation is not distorted.

question: Is the quoted price for one unit, one set or one carton?
answer: The quoted price is per unit unless it says otherwise; sets and cartons are priced separately. Tell me which line you are reading and I will confirm the basis.

question: Does the price include the retail box, manual, barcode and logo?
answer: The base price covers the product and the standard pack. A retail box, printed manual, barcode labelling and your logo are separate line items when they are customised, and I will show each one.

question: What are the one-time setup charges versus recurring unit costs?
answer: One-time charges are the setup and tooling; the unit cost is the recurring part. I will separate them in the quotation so you can see what you pay once and what you pay per order.

question: What quantity makes a custom box economical?
answer: It depends on the box structure and the printing, not on one threshold. I can show the unit effect at two quantities — your trial volume and the next step up — so you can see where the setup stops dominating. What is your trial volume?
note: 给比较口径，不反抛问题

question: Can you separate the product price from the packaging price?
answer: Yes, I can quote the product and the packaging as separate lines, which is also useful if you later change the box. Tell me which pack you are considering.

question: Is VAT included in the price you showed me?
answer: Prices are quoted ex-works or FOB and do not include import VAT or duty. If you need a landed figure, tell me the destination and I will show the components separately.

question: What would my estimated landed cost be if I use my own forwarder?
answer: I can give you the ex-works or FOB cost and the carton data; the freight and duty depend on your forwarder and your rate. Send their quote and I will build the landed cost with you.

question: Can you show margin scenarios with different retail prices, not one optimistic price?
answer: Yes — I can show two or three retail price points against the same landed cost, so you see the margin range rather than one optimistic case. What retail band are you planning?
note: 多情景，不给单一乐观值

question: How did you calculate that gross margin?
answer: I will show the formula and every input: landed cost, retail price, marketplace fee and returns allowance. If an input is your estimate rather than ours, I will mark it.

question: Does your margin estimate include marketplace fees, returns and promotions?
answer: Only if we put them in; the base calculation does not include marketplace fees, returns or promotions. Tell me the fee level you work with and I will add them as separate lines.

question: Can you quote an alternative configuration to meet my target retail price?
answer: Yes — we can change the packaging, the accessory set or the material to reach a retail price, and I will show what each change does. What is the target retail price and the channel?
note: 给替代配置，不降规格隐瞒

question: Can you quote in EUR as well as USD?
answer: Yes, I can quote in both, using the same cost basis; the exchange rate and its date will be shown on the quotation so the two versions reconcile.

question: We usually buy one mixed container. What other products can we add?
answer: Beyond your three main products, I would add one grooming consumable, one leash or harness variant, and a filter pack for the fountains. That gives breadth without opening another category. Which container size are you planning?

question: Can the MOQ be met across several SKUs rather than per SKU?
answer: Yes — for a mixed container the MOQ is usually counted across the order rather than per SKU, provided each SKU still meets a minimum run. Tell me the mix and I will confirm the exact rule.
note: 合并 MOQ 需按工艺确认

question: How many cartons of each SKU would you suggest for a mixed container?
answer: That depends on the carton size and the share you want for each SKU. Give me the container and the priority items, and I will propose carton counts.

question: What is the CBM and gross weight of the complete assortment?
answer: I will total both once the carton counts are fixed; the CBM is the sum of carton volume, and the gross weight includes pallets if you use them. Which mix version?

question: What is the volume left after the three main products?
answer: I will calculate the residual space after those three and tell you what fits — usually one or two smaller SKUs plus filler. Send the quantities you have in mind.

question: Could you propose two mix options: low-risk test and higher-value assortment?
answer: Yes: a low-risk version weighted to grooming and leashes, and a higher-value version with fountains and feeders. I will build both with carton counts and CBM. Which container?

question: Can you hold space for products from another supplier?
answer: Yes, we can leave space, but the volume has to be reserved before loading and the other supplier's cartons must be export-packed. Tell me the CBM they need.

question: Can we load heavy cartons at the bottom and fragile goods separately?
answer: Yes — heavy cartons go at the bottom and fragile items are separated with dividers or a top layer. Tell me which SKUs are fragile and I will mark the loading plan.

question: Will palletizing reduce the number of cartons we can load?
answer: Pallets take up height and floor space, so you usually load fewer cartons than a floor-loaded container. I will calculate both versions so you can weigh the handling benefit against the volume.

question: Does the proposed mix exceed the container weight limit or door clearance?
answer: I will check both against the container limit and the door height; overlength or overweight is easier to catch before booking than at the gate. Which mix?

question: Can you share a loading sketch rather than just total CBM?
answer: Yes, I can provide a loading sketch with the carton sequence, not just a CBM total. Tell me the container type and I will prepare it with the mix.

question: What happens if one SKU is delayed but the rest are ready to load?
answer: We can load what is ready and hold the delayed SKU for a later shipment, or delay the whole container if the mix must ship together. Which is better for your launch?

question: Can you split the shipment between LCL and FCL?
answer: Yes, that is possible: the ready items by LCL and the balance by FCL, though two shipments add cost. Tell me the volumes and I will compare it with waiting.

question: We have limited warehouse space; can you keep the first batch smaller?
answer: Yes — we can release in two shipments or hold finished stock for scheduled pickup, subject to storage space at our end. Tell me the monthly sell-through you expect.

question: What artwork format do you need for the logo and box?
answer: Vector AI or PDF with fonts outlined works best; for images, 300 dpi at final size. Send what you have and I will tell you if it needs adjusting before printing.

question: Can you send the dieline with bleed and safe areas?
answer: Yes, I will send the dieline with bleed and safe areas marked. Tell me the box style and whether your designer works in AI or PDF.

question: Who checks the Polish-language text on the packaging?
answer: The translation should be approved by you or your importer; we check placement and print quality, not the language. If you send the text, I will flag anything that does not fit.

question: Can we approve a physical color-box proof before mass production?
answer: Yes, a physical proof can be made before mass production, and written approval is needed before printing. It is usually charged and adds time. Which pack?

question: Will you send photos of the first printed cartons for sign-off?
answer: Yes, I will send photos of the first printed cartons for sign-off before the run continues. Tell me what you need to see — colour, text or the barcode area.

question: Can our design include a QR code that links to our own instructions?
answer: Yes, a QR code can be printed and linked to your instructions, as long as the destination is under your control. Send the URL and the size you want.

question: Can the box use our EAN code without adding your branding?
answer: Yes, the box can carry your EAN and no supplier branding. Send the code and the artwork, and confirm whether the carton also needs it.

question: Does the box have enough space for local importer details?
answer: Yes, we can leave a panel for the importer's name and address. Send the text and the required size, and I will check it fits the layout.

question: Can we use a plain box first and switch to branded packaging later?
answer: Yes — start with a plain box and a label, then move to printed packaging once the volume supports the setup. That is often the cheaper route for a first run.

question: Who owns the printed plates, molds and editable artwork?
answer: It depends on the asset and on what the agreement says. Your brand and your artwork are normally yours; tooling and printed plates are usually governed by the contract, because who pays for them affects the ownership. I will confirm the terms for each item in writing rather than assume a default. Which assets are you asking about?
note: 归属按来源与合同分别核实，不口头定性

question: Can you store unused printed packaging for future orders?
answer: We can hold unused printed packaging for a period if there is space, but it is not indefinite and it is agreed per order. Tell me the quantity and the expected reuse date.

question: Is the sample from the same production process as the bulk order?
answer: Samples come off the same process as production, but a sample run is smaller, so some steps are done by hand. I will tell you which parts differ if that matters for your evaluation.

question: Can you send a sample from the actual production line rather than a showroom?
answer: Yes, I can pull a sample from a current production run rather than the showroom, if the model is running. Tell me the model and I will check the schedule.

question: Can you send one sample with our packaging and one without?
answer: Yes, two units — one in retail packaging and one without — so you can compare the pack and the product separately. Confirm the model and address.

question: Can we review a golden sample and sign it before production?
answer: Yes, we can produce a golden sample, sign it and keep a copy for both sides before production. That is the reference for any later comparison.

question: Will you keep a sealed reference sample for both parties?
answer: Yes, we keep a sealed reference sample and so should you; the seal and the date are recorded. I will note it on the order.

question: What happens if the bulk goods differ from the approved sample?
answer: If the bulk differs from the approved sample, we treat it as a non-conformity and correct it at our cost before shipment. The comparison is against the signed sample, not a photo.

question: Can our inspector compare the shipment with the signed reference sample?
answer: Yes, your inspector can compare against the signed reference sample; we will have it available at the inspection. Tell me the inspection date.

question: Can you send samples from the first production batch?
answer: Yes, we can send samples from the first production batch before the rest is packed. That is usually the most useful check.

question: Which parts do you manufacture yourselves and which are outsourced?
answer: Injection moulding, assembly and packing are in-house; some components — pumps, batteries, electronics — come from specialist suppliers. Tell me which part matters and I will confirm its source.

question: Is this particular SKU made at the factory shown in your video?
answer: I will confirm the production site for that SKU rather than assume it runs on the line in the video. Send the model code and I will check.

question: Can you show the workshop for this model, not just the showroom?
answer: Yes, I can show the workshop where that model runs, not just the showroom. Tell me the model and I will arrange the footage or a live call.

question: Does the name on your business license match the contracting entity?
answer: The contracting entity is the company on the PI and the licence; if a different name appears anywhere, that is worth flagging before payment. Send me what you have and I will reconcile it.

question: Are the test reports issued for the exact model and brand we will import?
answer: Reports are issued for a specific model and applicant; I will check that the model and the brand on the report match what you will import. Send the model code.

question: Can we speak with your quality manager during the factory audit?
answer: Yes, I can arrange that during the audit or on a separate call. Tell me the topic so the right person joins.

question: Do you have batch traceability for components and finished goods?
answer: Yes — components and finished goods are recorded by batch, which is how a claim is traced back. I can show the record format on a call.

question: Who makes the pump, battery or filter component?
answer: Those come from specialist suppliers rather than our moulding line. Tell me the model and I will confirm the supplier tier and whether the part is standard or custom.

question: Can an independent inspector visit during production?
answer: Yes, an inspector can visit during production, not only before shipment. Tell me the stage you want covered and I will confirm access.

question: What inspections do you perform before packing?
answer: Incoming component checks, in-line assembly checks and a final random inspection before packing. I can send the checklist for the model so you see what is measured.

question: Can you share the inspection checklist for this model?
answer: Yes, I can share the inspection checklist for the model, including the cosmetic and functional points. Tell me the model code.

question: Which faults are classified as critical, major or minor?
answer: Critical covers safety and function failure, major covers a fault a customer would reject, minor covers appearance within tolerance. The definitions go into the inspection standard so both sides use the same wording.
note: 只定义类别，不建议阈值

question: Can we set an agreed AQL before production starts?
answer: Yes — the AQL should be agreed and written into the order before production starts, not after. Tell me the level your quality team uses and I will have ours confirm whether we can inspect to it.

question: Will you perform a drop test on the retail box and master carton?
answer: We can run a drop test on the retail box and the master carton, and record the result. Tell me the drop height and the standard you need, and I will confirm what we can perform.

question: Can you test every electrical unit before packing?
answer: I will confirm whether the line does 100% function testing or sampling for that model; it differs by product. Tell me the model and I will check the process sheet.

question: How do you test the pump noise level and flow rate?
answer: Noise and flow are measured on a sample basis with a calibrated setup; I will send the method and the recorded values for the model. Tell me which model.

question: Can you provide photos or a video of the final random inspection?
answer: Yes, we can send photos or a short video of the final random inspection, including the carton and the units checked. Tell me the order and the date.

question: How do you trace a complaint back to a specific lot?
answer: Each carton carries the batch and production date, so a complaint is traced back through the packing record to the component lot. Send the batch number and I will start.

question: What are the acceptance criteria for color variation or scratches?
answer: The criteria are agreed in the inspection standard: a colour reference under defined light, and a limit on visible scratches by area. I will send the wording for the model so it is measurable.

question: Which documents apply to this exact SKU and destination market?
answer: Documents depend on the SKU and the destination, so I will list what applies and what we actually hold rather than answer for the range. Send the model and the market.

question: Can you send the complete report, not just a certificate cover page?
answer: Yes — where a report exists, we send the full document including the test pages and the validity. Tell me the model and I will check what the laboratory issued.

question: Is the report still valid for the current materials and design?
answer: Validity depends on whether the materials or the design changed since the report; if they did, it is re-tested. Tell me the model and the change and I will check.

question: Who is listed as the manufacturer and importer on the label?
answer: The manufacturer is on the label as the production entity; the importer is normally your company for the destination market. We will print whichever details your market requires, once confirmed.

question: Can you provide the declaration of conformity for the exact model?
answer: A declaration of conformity is issued for a specific model and applicant, so I will check whether one exists for the exact model before saying yes. Send the code.

question: Are any registration or labeling duties left to the importer?
answer: Some duties sit with the importer rather than the supplier — registration and local language are the usual ones. I will list what we can support and what stays with you.

question: Can we review the user manual and safety warnings before printing?
answer: Yes, send the manual and we will review it for print layout and consistency with the product; the safety wording should be approved by your side.
note: 版式我们看，措辞客户定

question: If a component changes, will the compliance documents be reviewed again?
answer: Yes — a component change triggers a review of the affected documents, and we record which ones were reissued. Tell me the change and I will confirm the scope.

question: Can you provide the material composition of the retail packaging?
answer: Yes, I can provide the material composition of the retail pack — paper, plastic and any coating — for your packaging reporting. Tell me which pack.

question: What evidence supports your environmental or recycled-content claims?
answer: Claims need evidence, so I will tell you what we can support with documents and what we cannot. Which claim are you planning to make?

question: Can you confirm whether the batteries are included or shipped separately?
answer: It depends on the model and the shipping method; some ship with batteries installed, some with them packed separately. Tell me the model and I will confirm the configuration.

question: Who checks product-specific requirements for sale in our target country?
answer: The importer is responsible for the final check in most markets; we can supply the documents and answer technical questions. I will tell you what we can confirm for the model.

question: When will you send the shipping mark and draft packing list?
answer: I will send the shipping mark and the draft packing list once the carton counts are final, usually a few days before the booking. Tell me the order and the expected date.

question: Can you ship under our forwarder's booking?
answer: Yes, we can ship under your booking; you send the booking confirmation and we coordinate the pickup and the documents. Which forwarder?

question: Who pays for origin terminal handling and loading?
answer: Origin terminal handling and loading follow the Incoterm: under FOB they are normally on our side up to the vessel, and under EXW they are on yours. I will confirm the split in the quotation.

question: Can you consolidate goods from two factories under one booking?
answer: Yes, if both suppliers deliver to us before the cut-off and the cartons are export-packed. Send their details and the ready dates.

question: Can you send photos of carton marks before loading?
answer: Yes, I will send photos of the marks before loading so you can check them against the packing list. Tell me if any mark must follow your format.

question: Can you provide the container number and seal number after loading?
answer: Yes, I will send the container number, seal number and the loading photos after the container is sealed. That is part of the shipping update.

question: Can you issue a draft commercial invoice for our customs broker to check?
answer: Yes, I can issue a draft invoice for your broker to check before the final version. Send the details they need to see.

question: Can the invoice and packing list show our internal SKU codes?
answer: Yes, we can show your SKU codes alongside our model codes, as long as the customs description stays accurate. Send the mapping.
note: 内部码可加，报关描述不变
