question: Can you separate the country-of-origin information by SKU?
answer: Yes, the country of origin can be shown per SKU rather than once for the shipment. Send the format your broker expects.
note: 逐 SKU 标注原产地

question: What documents will be available before the vessel departs?
answer: Usually the packing list, commercial invoice, and the booking or B/L draft; certificates depend on the destination. I will confirm the list for your case.

question: Can you arrange an inspection before the container is sealed?
answer: Yes, we can arrange the inspection before the container is sealed, which is the right sequence. Tell me the date and the inspector.

question: Can you send a formal quotation on company letterhead?
answer: Yes, I can issue it on company letterhead with the validity date and the payment terms. Tell me the entity name and any reference number.

question: Can you issue a pro forma invoice with every SKU listed separately?
answer: Yes, the PI can list each SKU separately with quantity, unit price and carton details. Send the final quantities.

question: Can you add our purchase-order number to all documents?
answer: Yes, your PO number can appear on the PI, invoice and packing list. Send the number and the exact format.

question: Does the quote match the specification sheet and packaging artwork?
answer: I will check the quotation against the specification sheet and the approved artwork before sending, and flag any line that differs. Send the version you are comparing.

question: Can you confirm the warranty and inspection terms in the contract?
answer: Yes — warranty and inspection terms belong in the contract, and I will confirm the wording with our side before it is signed. Which points matter most?

question: Can you sign our supplier agreement or code of conduct?
answer: We can review your supplier agreement or code of conduct; some clauses need our side to approve. Send the document and I will start the review.

question: We need three comparable offers for internal approval. Can you itemize yours?
answer: Yes, I can itemise the offer so it can sit next to the other two: product, packaging, tooling, testing and terms as separate lines. Tell me the comparison format your committee uses.

question: Could you provide a sample invoice for our finance department?
answer: Yes, I can provide a sample invoice layout for your finance team, marked as a sample and not payable.

question: Who will sign the contract on your side?
answer: The contract is signed by the legal representative of the contracting entity, and I will confirm the name and title before you issue it. Tell me which entity you are contracting with.

question: Can we place a blanket order and release stock in batches?
answer: A blanket order with scheduled releases is possible if the quantities and the release dates are fixed; storage and price validity have to be agreed. Tell me the annual quantity and the release plan.

question: Can we revise the PI if the quantity changes before payment?
answer: Yes, the PI can be revised before payment; after payment it becomes a change order. Tell me the new quantity and I will issue the revision.

question: I cannot find the payment link in my order. Can you check?
answer: I will check the order status on my side and tell you what the platform shows. Send the order number so I look at the right one.

question: The product specification in the order differs from our chat. Can you correct it?
answer: Send the line that differs and what it should say; I will compare it with the agreed chat record and correct the order before production.

question: Why does the order show a different shipping date?
answer: The date on the order is usually a platform estimate; the confirmed date is the one we agree in writing. Tell me the order number and the date you see, and I will reconcile them.

question: Can you upload the agreed artwork and inspection standard to the order?
answer: Yes, both can be attached to the order so they sit with the contract. Send the final artwork and the inspection standard you approved.

question: My card payment was declined. Is the order still open?
answer: A declined payment usually leaves the order open but unpaid; I will check the status. Do not retry more than once — tell me what the platform shows and I will confirm.

question: I paid, but the order status has not changed. What should we verify?
answer: Send the payment reference and the amount; I will check with our finance team and confirm when it is applied. Platform status can lag by a day.

question: Can you provide the invoice required by our accounting team?
answer: Yes, I can issue the invoice with the details your accounting team needs. Tell me the required fields and the entity.

question: Can we change the delivery address before dispatch?
answer: It depends on the stage: before booking it is straightforward, after booking the carrier may charge a change fee. Send the new address and I will check where the shipment stands.

question: Can you explain which charges appear on the platform order?
answer: I will break down what the order shows — product, shipping and any platform fee — and flag anything that is an estimate rather than a charge. Send the order number.

question: Has production started yet?
answer: I will check with production and confirm the stage — materials released, moulding or assembly. Send the order number and I will come back today.

question: Can you share photos of the first finished units?
answer: Yes, I will ask for photos of the first finished units before the run continues. Tell me which details you want to see.

question: What percentage of the order is complete?
answer: We track by stage rather than a percentage, because a percentage hides which step is late. I will tell you what is finished and what is next.

question: Can we increase the quantity before packaging is printed?
answer: It depends on whether the materials are already released; before printing it is usually possible. Tell me the new quantity and I will confirm the price effect and the date.

question: Can we change one color after the deposit is paid?
answer: A colour change after deposit depends on whether the material is already ordered; if not, it can be changed with a revised PI. Tell me the colour and I will check.

question: Why has the shipment date moved?
answer: I will tell you exactly which step moved it — material, printing or booking — rather than give a new date without a reason. Send the order number.

question: Can you ship the completed SKUs first?
answer: It is possible to ship the completed SKUs first, but it splits the booking and adds cost. Tell me the priority SKUs and I will compare it with waiting.

question: What is the earliest date the inspector can visit?
answer: I will confirm the earliest date the goods will be packed and ready for inspection, then you can book. Tell me the inspector and the order.

question: Can you send a weekly progress update until loading?
answer: Yes, I will send a short weekly update with the stage, photos where useful, and anything that could affect the date. Is Friday suitable?

question: If the packaging printer is delayed, what options do we have?
answer: We can keep the product on schedule and pack later, switch to a stock box for part of the run, or move the date. I will confirm which is possible once I know the delay.

question: Can you confirm that no components were substituted without approval?
answer: I can confirm that no component is substituted without written approval; if a substitution is proposed, it comes to you with the reason and the effect first.

question: The carton count does not match the packing list. Can you investigate?
answer: Send the packing list, the count you found and photos of the carton marks; I will trace it against the loading record and come back with what happened.

question: We found damaged cartons on arrival. What evidence do you need?
answer: Photos of the cartons before opening, the damage itself, and the marks; then the units affected. That is enough to open the claim.

question: Several units are missing from a sealed carton.
answer: Send the carton weight, the packing list line and photos of the sealed carton before opening; we will check the packing record and the count.

question: The product color differs from the approved sample.
answer: Send photos under daylight next to the approved sample and the batch number; I will check whether it is within the agreed tolerance or a deviation.

question: The barcode scans to the wrong SKU.
answer: Send the barcode and the SKU it reads as; if it is our label error we will reissue the labels and cover the correction.

question: The pump stops after a few hours of use.
answer: Send the batch number, the failure pattern and a short video; I will check whether it is the pump or the power supply before proposing a replacement.

question: A customer reported a safety issue. What is the escalation process?
answer: Send the details and the batch number today; safety cases go to our quality lead the same day, and we will agree the containment step with you before any public statement.

question: Can you send replacement parts for the affected batch?
answer: Yes, send the affected quantity and the batch number; we will confirm which parts and how they ship.

question: We need the production batch number for our claim.
answer: It is on the carton label and the packing list; if it is missing I will trace it from the order and the shipping date.

question: Who handles a recall if we discover a serious defect?
answer: A recall is handled jointly: we provide the batch records and the technical file, and you lead the market action as importer. We will agree the split in writing if it happens.

question: Can you provide a root-cause analysis and corrective action report?
answer: Yes, I can request a root-cause analysis and corrective-action report for the batch; it usually takes a few days because it involves production and QC.

question: The first batch sold well. What is the reorder lead time?
answer: Repeat orders are usually faster because the artwork and tooling are already approved; tell me the quantity and I will confirm the date.

question: Can you reserve materials if we share a rolling forecast?
answer: A rolling forecast helps us reserve materials, but the commitment needs a firm window and a quantity. Tell me the quarterly plan.

question: Will you keep the same packaging and specifications for repeat orders?
answer: Yes, we keep the approved specification and artwork on file for repeat orders; any change is flagged before production.

question: Will you notify us before discontinuing this model?
answer: Yes, we will tell you before a model is discontinued so you can place a last order or plan a replacement. Tell me which models matter most.

question: Can you reserve replacement filters for the next season?
answer: Filters can be reserved with the order or held separately; the quantity and the holding period need to be agreed. Tell me your season.

question: Can you supply spare parts separately from the main product?
answer: Yes, spare parts can be supplied separately from the main product, with their own packing list. Tell me which parts.

question: Could we reorder at a lower quantity using the existing printed boxes?
answer: If the printed boxes already exist, a lower reorder is usually possible because the setup is done. Tell me the quantity and I will confirm.

question: Can you hold finished stock for scheduled releases?
answer: We can hold finished stock for scheduled releases for an agreed period, subject to space. Tell me the release plan.

question: If demand doubles, what additional capacity can you offer?
answer: I will check the line capacity for that model rather than promise a multiple. If demand doubles, we would plan a second run and confirm the date.

question: Can you provide white-background photos and a short product video?
answer: Yes, we can provide white-background images and a short product video. Tell me the resolution and the aspect ratio your listing needs.

question: Can we use your photos in our retail listings?
answer: Yes, you may use our product photos for listings of our products, and we can confirm that in writing. Please do not alter the product appearance in the edit.

question: Do you have dimensions and weights for parcel-shipping fees?
answer: I will send the unit dimensions and the packed weight once the packaging is fixed; both affect the parcel rate. Which model and pack?

question: Will the individual box withstand direct-to-consumer delivery?
answer: The retail box is designed for shelf and light parcel handling; for direct-to-consumer I would recommend a mail-order box or an outer sleeve. Tell me the average parcel route.

question: Can you prepare FBA carton labels to our instructions?
answer: Yes, we can apply FBA carton labels to your instructions, including the placement and the number per carton. Send the label file and the rule.

question: Can you provide a product manual in editable format?
answer: Yes, I can send the manual in an editable format so you can localise it. Tell me which language and whether the layout must stay fixed.

question: Do you have lifestyle photos that we have permission to use?
answer: We have lifestyle images we can share for use with these products; I will confirm the usage scope in writing before you publish. Which channel?

question: Can you remove your brand from all product images?
answer: Yes, we can supply images without our branding. Tell me whether you need the product retouched or just the logo removed.

question: Does the product come with a warranty card or local-language insert?
answer: A warranty card and a local-language insert can be added; the wording should be approved by your side. Tell me the language and the size.

question: Can we place a trial listing before the custom packaging is ready?
answer: Yes — you can list with stock packaging first and switch to custom packaging later; the product images stay the same. Tell me the launch date.

question: Will you attend the upcoming trade show?
answer: Tell me which show and the dates; if we are attending I will confirm the booth and arrange a time.

question: Can we meet your production manager at the booth?
answer: I will check whether our production manager is at the show; if not, we can arrange a video call from the factory instead.

question: Can you arrange a live video tour of the actual production line?
answer: Yes, we can arrange a live tour of the line producing your model. Tell me the time window and whether you want to record it.

question: Can we visit without a buying agent present?
answer: Yes, you are welcome to visit without an agent; tell me the date and who is coming, and I will arrange access and an interpreter if needed.

question: Are you available for a call during our business hours?
answer: Yes — give me your time zone and the window, and I will confirm a slot that falls inside it.

question: Could you show the product working live on camera?
answer: Yes, we can demonstrate the product on camera, including the functions you specify. Which model and which functions?

question: Can you introduce your inspector to our team on a video call?
answer: Yes, I can bring our QC lead onto a call with your team. Tell me the topic and the time.

question: Can you schedule a follow-up after our internal product review?
answer: Yes — tell me the date of your review and what you need from us beforehand so the follow-up is useful.

question: We have decided to work with another supplier.
answer: Thank you for telling me directly. If it helps, I would like to know what decided it — price, specification or timing — so we can improve. I wish you well with the launch.

question: The project is on hold until next quarter.
answer: Understood — I will keep the file open and check in before the quarter starts, unless you prefer otherwise. Is there anything you need from us in the meantime?

question: This product did not pass our internal review.
answer: Thank you for the feedback. Could you tell me which point failed — specification, price or packaging? It would help us propose a version that fits.

question: Our retail partner rejected the proposed packaging.
answer: That is useful to know. Send me the reason they gave, and I will propose two alternative structures rather than defend the first one.

question: We no longer need this item, but keep us informed about new models.
answer: Noted — I will stop sending on this item and keep you updated only when something genuinely new in your category appears.

question: Please remove this model from the quotation.
answer: Done — I will remove that model and reissue the quotation with the remaining items. Tell me if the quantity changes as a result.

question: I am no longer responsible for this category; contact our new buyer.
answer: Thank you for the introduction. Could you share their name and email, and whether they prefer the platform or email? I will send a short handover summary.

question: Our budget has been frozen.
answer: Understood. I will pause the quotation and keep the specification on file; when the budget reopens, we can restart from the same version.

question: I read your proposal but need time to review it.
answer: Please take the time you need to review it. If there are points you would like to compare or discuss internally, I can help make those easier to work through. I can put together a brief summary of the product options, the terms already confirmed, and any points still to be agreed. That way, you can focus on the decisions that matter without going through the full proposal again. Would that be useful for your review?

question: We still have stock from last season.
answer: That makes sense. Tell me when you expect to run down the stock and I will check the production slot and price for that window.

question: Do not send more catalogs unless they match our category.
answer: Noted — I will only send items in your category from now on. Tell me the categories to keep and I will adjust.

question: Please change the beneficiary account to this personal name.
answer: I cannot change the beneficiary to a personal name; payment has to go to the company account shown on the PI. If the instruction you received shows a personal name, please do not send it and let me confirm the correct details.
note: 收款账户只对公司账户

question: Send the entire customer list and we will decide what to order.
answer: No — we do not share our customer list. I can share the models we supply and the markets they go to, without names. Which market are you in?

question: We need your employee's passport before sharing our purchase order.
answer: We do not provide an employee's passport. Company verification is done through the business licence and the platform records; I can send those.

question: Click this portal and enter the one-time code to receive payment.
answer: We will not enter a one-time code or log in through an unknown portal. Payment details are confirmed on the PI and verified with the bank. Send me what you received and I will check it.

question: We can pay if you declare a lower value on the invoice.
answer: We cannot declare a value below the actual invoice; that is a false declaration and it puts both sides at risk. I will issue the invoice at the real value.

question: Can you remove the country-of-origin label?
answer: We cannot remove the country-of-origin marking; customs clearance and traceability depend on it. I can check whether the placement can be changed so it does not affect your design.

question: Please copy this competitor's protected logo exactly.
answer: We cannot reproduce a competitor's protected logo. We can build a similar construction under your own brand, or work from a design you own.

question: Pay our registration fee first to participate in our tender.
answer: We do not pay a registration fee to participate in a tender. Send the tender documents and, if it is genuine, we will respond through the official channel.

question: We sent too much money; refund the difference to a third party.
answer: We cannot refund an overpayment to a third party. If a payment was genuinely overpaid, it goes back to the original payer's account after verification.

question: Can you ship goods that differ from the approved order description?
answer: No — the goods have to match the approved order description and the documents. If something needs to change, we revise the order first.

question: Will the grooming glove work on wet fur as well as dry fur?
answer: The glove works on wet fur for washing and on dry fur for loose hair; wet use needs a little more pressure. Which coat type are you buying for?

question: Is the clipper suitable for cats with dark nails?
answer: Dark nails are harder because the quick is not visible, so a clipper with a safety guard and small cuts works better than a full cut. I will confirm whether the model includes a guard.

question: What happens if the LED fails? Is the light replaceable?
answer: On most models the LED is a sealed module rather than a user-replaceable bulb; if it fails within warranty it is replaced as a unit. Tell me the model and I will confirm.

question: Does the clipper include a battery, and is it replaceable?
answer: It depends on the model — some are rechargeable built-in, some use AA cells. Tell me the model and I will confirm which, and whether the cell is user-replaceable.

question: How often should the fountain filter be replaced under normal use?
answer: It depends on use and on how much hair reaches the filter; the manual gives the model-specific interval. Tell me the model and I will send the exact guidance.

question: Can the fountain be cleaned in a dishwasher, and which parts?
answer: Only the parts marked dishwasher-safe should go in; the pump and the electrical base never do. I will send the list for the model.

question: What happens if the fountain runs without water?
answer: The pump is designed to run with water; running dry can damage it. If the model has a low-water cut-off I will confirm it, and either way the advice is to keep the level above the minimum.

question: Do you sell replacement pumps and filters for this exact model?
answer: Yes, both are available for current models. Tell me the model and I will confirm the part numbers and the minimum order.

question: Can pets chew through the power cable? Are any protective accessories available?
answer: The cable is not chew-proof. A cord cover or a cable route out of reach is the practical answer; I will check whether we offer a braided option for that model.

question: Which components touch drinking water, and can you identify their materials?
answer: The parts that contact water are the bowl, the filter housing and the spout; I will confirm the material of each for the model rather than describe the whole product.

question: Is the bowl stable enough for larger pets?
answer: Stability depends on the base width and the weight of the bowl when full; for larger pets I would check the wider-base version. What size are the pets?

question: Can you provide a test video of the fountain's actual noise level?
answer: Yes, I can record a noise test on the model, with the meter visible so the figure is meaningful. Tell me the distance you want it measured at.

question: Can you provide instructions for cleaning the filter housing?
answer: Yes, I will send the cleaning steps for the housing, including how often to rinse it and what not to use. Tell me the model.

question: Buyer sends a product card followed by “Interested”.
answer: Thanks — I can see the item. Tell me the quantity you have in mind and whether you need your own logo or packaging, and I will send the price.

question: Buyer forwards an RFQ document listing technical requirements but no question.
answer: I have read the requirements. Before I quote, tell me whether the quantities are fixed and whether the listed specifications are mandatory or open to an equivalent.

question: Buyer sends a purchase order as an attachment without explanation.
answer: Thank you for the PO. I will check it against the quotation and confirm the specification, quantity and delivery date before we accept it. Is there a required ship date?

question: Buyer reacts with a thumbs-up to the quotation but does not confirm an order.
answer: Glad it looks right. A thumbs-up is not something I can put on the order, so tell me whether you are approving the price, the specification or both, and I will send the PI.

question: Buyer reads the quotation and sends only “Noted”.
answer: Noted. If anything in the quotation needs adjusting, tell me which line; otherwise I will keep it as the current version.

question: Buyer sends an annotated packaging image with circled edits.
answer: I can see the circled changes. I will list them back to you one by one for confirmation before the artwork is revised, so nothing is missed.

question: Buyer sends a warehouse address without confirming shipping terms.
answer: Thanks for the address. Before I can quote delivery I need the shipping term — DDP, CIF or your forwarder — because the address alone does not tell me who clears customs.

question: Buyer sends a competitor quote with prices blacked out.
answer: I can see the structure even with the prices hidden. Tell me which line you want me to match and I will compare like for like.

question: Buyer sends “Approved” without stating whether the sample, artwork or PI is approved.
answer: Thank you — could you confirm what is approved: the sample, the artwork or the PI? Each one releases a different next step, and I do not want to start the wrong one.

question: Buyer sends an updated quantity table without explaining whether it replaces the old one.
answer: I have the new table. Does it replace the earlier quantities or add to them? I will update the quotation once you confirm.

question: Buyer sends a customs-broker checklist without saying which documents are mandatory.
answer: I have the checklist. I will mark which documents we provide and which your broker must obtain, then send it back so nothing is assumed.

question: Buyer forwards feedback from a store buyer but does not specify the final decision.
answer: Thanks for forwarding it. Is this feedback for revision, or a decision to proceed? If it is feedback, tell me which points are must-change.
